verdict.rationale: Instinct is documented as an autonomous personal assistant that carries out multi-step errands such as booking rides, handymen and appointments. Hands-on reviewers confirm the delegate-and-report loop: they asked over iMessage, it made calls in the background, and confirmations came back in the same chat. It also handled podcast booking follow-ups on its own, pinging the user only when needed, and testers report multi-step travel rebookings and CRM work. The 'return for my review' part is weak: testers report it sent an email without checking first and made an unwanted $200 reservation. missing for 10: a documented review/approval step before actions are finalized, first-party detail on how background tasks are tracked and handed back.
